name: com.us.mechanic/auto-manual
title: Mechanic Atlas Auto Manual
description: Car repair manual for AI chat: specs, repair steps, recalls, complaints and factory manual links.

tools.name: find_vehicle
tools.description: Look up a vehicle by make and model, with an optional year. Returns the engines, transmissions and drive types built that year, how many repair jobs apply, and the free factory manual archive links.

tools.name: repair_jobs
tools.description: List the repair and maintenance jobs that apply to a vehicle, grouped by section, with a difficulty rank from 1 (easy) to 5 (hardest). Titles only.

section.description: Optional section filter, for example Brakes or Cooling

tools.name: factory_manual_links
tools.description: Links to the free factory service manual archives (Operation CHARM and LEMON Manuals) for a year and make, and whether each archive has that year.

tools.name: recalls
tools.description: Safety recalls for a year, make and model from NHTSA, read live.

tools.name: complaints
tools.description: Owner complaints filed with NHTSA for a year, make and model: counts by component and the latest few.

tools.name: repair_guides
tools.description: Find our published repair and buyer guides by make, model, year or topic. Returns titles, links and short summaries.

topic.description: Optional words to match, for example timing chain

tools.name: mechanic_market
tools.description: Auto repair business counts by trade, shops per 100,000 people and mechanic pay for a US state, or a county in it. From the Census Bureau and the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

state.description: State name or two letter code

tools.name: get_access
tools.description: Make a free access key for the full manual from the person's email. The first 20 cars are free. Shows the key once, so the person should save it. Ask for their email; never make one up.

tools.name: full_manual
tools.description: The full manual for one year, make and model: sourced capacities, fluids, torques and intervals for each engine, and the step by step procedure for any job (tools, specs to check, steps, what to do after, cautions). The first pull of a car unlocks it for 30 days and uses a free pull, a membership car or $1 from the wallet. Pulls on an unlocked car are free.

key.description: The person's access key from get_access

engine.description: Optional engine, for example 2.5L or 5.3L V8

job.description: Optional job, for example front brakes, timing belt or spark plugs. Leave out for the spec sheet and the job list

confirm.description: true only after the person says yes to a $1 charge

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: Free pulls left, wallet, membership, the cars unlocked right now, and how to pay.
